children: Electric Metals (USA) Limited reported its FEL-1 Study for a 200,000 tpy HPMSM plant came in ~3% below its PEA capex estimate and set a preliminary installed cost of $98.6M for an integrated 10,000 tpy EMM line. Both estimates carry ±50% accuracy and exclude certain costs.
Validates prior capex for 200kt HPMSM, supporting project economics and financing narratives.
Frames potential incremental spend for 10kt EMM, informing optionality and capital planning.
High uncertainty; numbers could swing materially as engineering advances.
Scalable design may lower incremental expansion capex and timelines.
Total project cost will be higher; investors should adjust capex expectations.

This is an early engineering de-risking step that affirms prior capex assumptions and outlines an EMM option. A larger catalyst would be site selection, permits, financing/offtake agreements, and a tighter Class 3/2 estimate confirming total capex and schedule.
